Company Description 
 Openvision Data provides comprehensive IT services for companies in Bucharest and Ilfov, including helpdesk, monitoring, and maintenance under an all-inclusive subscription model. Established in 2004, the company manages over 5,000 devices and has resolved more than 80,000 tickets, with remote response times under 15 minutes. Openvision Data offers IT support and maintenance, managed IT services (MSP), Microsoft 365 solutions, cybersecurity and NIS 2 compliance, VPS servers, and AI consulting and implementation. Services are delivered with transparent, public pricing and projects are scoped and billed separately. Every client relationship begins with a free IT audit and written report.
 Role Description 
 The Administrator IT role is a full-time, on-site position based in Bucharest, Romania. This role is responsible for providing day-to-day technical support to clients, including diagnosing and resolving hardware, software, and network issues both on-site and via remote tools. The Administrator IT will manage and monitor servers, workstations, and network equipment, perform regular maintenance, and ensure systems are updated and secure. The role includes configuring and administering Microsoft 365 environments, supporting cybersecurity measures, and contributing to documentation of incidents, solutions, and IT procedures. The Administrator IT will collaborate with colleagues and client teams to prioritize tickets, maintain service levels, and support continuous improvement of IT operations.
 Qualifications 
Strong Technical Support and Troubleshooting skills for hardware, software, and user issues
Experience with Network Administration, including routers, switches, firewalls, and VPNs
Hands-on System Administration skills for Windows servers, workstations, and Microsoft 365 environments
Solid foundation in Information Technology principles, including security, backups, and monitoring
Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tickets in a fast-paced helpdesk or MSP environment
Familiarity with cybersecurity best practices and compliance frameworks (e.g., NIS 2) is an advantage
Experience with virtualization, VPS hosting, or cloud services (such as Azure or other providers) is beneficial
Clear written and verbal communication skills in English; Romanian language skills strongly preferred
Proven ability to work on-site with client teams, with a customer-focused and solution-oriented mindset
Relevant technical certifications (e.g., CompTIA, Microsoft, Cisco) or equivalent hands-on experience
 Benefits 
Competitive salary starting from €1000 net, depending on experience.
Opportunity for career advancement.
Performance bonuses and incentives.
Mobile phone & Laptop.
Company car (for onsite interventions).
A friendly work atmosphere and cool colleagues.
Integration program with a mixed learning approach (e-learning & on-the-job training), to facilitate the best possible start and integration into our team.
Company headquarters near Piata Victoriei - Piata Domenii.
 Our colleague will benefit from comprehensive training regarding the working methods, alongside gaining vast experience due to the diversity of situations to be resolved. They will be backed by a dynamic, competent, and experienced team, working together to ensure contractual promises to clients are met.
